newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice - Levels steady, no new restrictions due.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice - Levels steady, no new restrictions due.

text.p: Baltic ice levels were little changed and last week's restrictions to navigation remained in force, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said in its twice-weekly ice report on Monday.

Four icebreakers were still on station near St Petersburg and Vyborg in the eastern Gulf of Finland, one near Porvoo and Loviisa, five in the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia, two in the middle, and one outside Rauma.
One ice-breaker was on station in the Gulf of Riga.

NOTES: New ice - forming, thin and still moving. Fast ice - not moving level flat ice. Level ice - thick flat ice.

Consolidated/compact - compact close ice. Windrow ice - reshaped by wind, thickness varies sharply. Rafted - ridges forming, 10-20 cm thick. Ridged - ridged or hummocked ice. Open - floes with water at rate of 4-6:10. Close ice - floes tightly packed.
